def factor_range_vol_of_vol_median_stable(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    median_range = range_.rolling(60, min_periods=20).median()
    std_range = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1)
    cv = std_range / median_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = -np.cbrt(cv)
    df_copy["factor_range_vol_of_vol_median_stable"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_vol_of_vol_median_stable"]
description: Mutates parent vol-of-vol mean-reversion by replacing the trailing 60-day mean range denominator with the trailing 60-day median range. The core mechanism remains high volatility of daily range relative to its typical level predicting lower forward returns; the median denominator is more robust to outlier wide-range days and should improve top-quantile payoff thickness while preserving the stable monotonic ranking (parent RankICIR=0.5300). One lightweight signed cube-root compression is retained as the only modifier.
